title: Unique Umami Vietnamese Tofu Canh Chua
description: A peppery and juicy Vietnamese dish perfect for a date night, featuring vegan white wine vinegar and simmered to perfection in a canh chua style.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and grated ginger and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms and bell peppers and cook until they are tender.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until it is lightly browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, whisk together the vegan white wine vinegar, tamarind paste, and vegetable broth.
Pour the vinegar mixture into the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Unique Umami Vietnamese Tofu Canh Chua hot over rice or noodles.
